title: Add a CHANGELOG seeded from the history
lead:
There is no CHANGELOG. A both-audience 1.0 needs one; the git history is rich
enough to seed it.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** automating changelog generation.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Users and contributors need a human record of what changed per release; "read
the git log" is not an acceptable substitute for a published tool.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Create `CHANGELOG.md` in Keep-a-Changelog style with an `[Unreleased]` section
and a `[1.0.0]` section seeded from the user-facing slices in the history
(reordering, notes, status/stats, HTML render, agent onboarding, install path,
JSON envelopes, …). Establish the convention that each release slice updates it.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
`CHANGELOG.md` reads cleanly and covers the notable user-facing changes; linked
from the README.
